api.CONFIG: immutable exported integer policy constants; authoritative values are reproduced below
api.normalizeEvent(event,{nowMs}): returns whitelisted normalized event or null; no wall clock or RNG calls
api.reduce(ledger,event,context={nowMs:ledge: pure; returns new ledger for first accepted event; returns identical input object for duplicate, invalid, stale epoch, unsupported schema/policy or retryable capacity rejection
api.coverageMs(occurrence): sum of disjoint observed media coverage ranges
api.summarize(ledger): local aggregate insight counts; no track identities
api.exposureMetrics(ledger,trackIds=ledger.t: eligible, activated, heard, neverActivated, activationCoveragePermille, heardCoveragePermille; repeated IDs are deduplicated
api.exportLedger(ledger,{includePrivate:true: explicit private local export, returns deep serializable copy; missing opt-in throws
api.importLedger(objectOrJson): {ok:true,ledger} or {ok:false,reason,preserved}; validates exact current fields, ordering, counters, coverage and watermark invariants; preserves unsupported or invalid source without fabricating history or resetting
api.setEnabled(ledger,enabled,eventIdentity,: idempotent control reducer; disable retains aggregates but closes all open occurrence measurements
api.resetLearning(ledger,eventIdentity,conte: clears learning tracks, occurrences and detailed journal; increments learningEpoch; retains durable deduplication and enabled flag
api.deleteHistory(ledger,eventIdentity,conte: deletes detailed journal, closed occurrences and lastHeardAtMs; retains compact aggregate taste/exposure and minimal deduplication tokens
api.deleteTrack(ledger,trackId,eventIdentity: deletes all track-specific learning, occurrence and detailed-journal rows; retains minimal deduplication tokens
api.deleteLedger(ledger,{enabled:false,nowMs: full private ledger deletion including deduplication; returns fresh disabled ledger with incremented epoch; adapters must rotate producer epoch

ids.generatedOccurrenceException: occurrenceId alone permits1..16384 well-formed UTF16 code units because the scheduler uses a JSON tuple of sessionId and playback sequence; track/event/producer/monotonicClock IDs retain1..1024
ids.normalization: none; no trimming, case folding or NFC; combining sequences remain distinct
ids.ordering: ascending unsigned UTF16 code-unit lexicographic order; locale-independent
ids.identityStorage: arrays of explicit structured IDs; no delimiter concatenation or object-property ID indexing

optional.timestampMs: safe nonnegative epoch integer, defaults injected effective now
optional.learningEpoch: nonnegative integer; when supplied must equal ledger epoch
optional.source: optional string; remote/session/preview suppress all personal evidence; other values removed
optional.reason: optional string|null; known infrastructure reason retained; an unknown nonempty outcome reason normalizes to unclassified and suppresses implicit evidence

eventCommon.unknownFields: removed before journaling; title/path/URL/credentials/tokens/features are never copied from events
eventCommon.optionalBooleanValidation: provided personal/replay/playing/discontinuity/userInitiated fields must be actual booleans or event rejects
eventCommon.controlAuthority: nonpersonal/remote/session/preview reset, enable, history deletion and track deletion controls reject unchanged

offered.effect: increment offered and bounded opportunityDebt; never count heard or activated

optional.durationMs: integer1..86400000 or null; unknown defaults null

activated.effect: confirmed activation only; increment exposure once and clear opportunityDebt; duplicate occurrence ID does not increment; replay count is factual separate metric

required.monotonicEndMs: nonnegative safe integer >= start and span<=60000

optional.discontinuity: must not equal true to accrue

interval.effect: clip previously observed monotonic overlap; add actual wall time separately from union of media ranges; no position-to-percent inference; require positive plausible media progress; seek/discontinuity/pause/buffer do not count; boot clock origins remain separate

optional.userInitiated: must equal true for deliberate skip/replay implicit evidence

outcome.effect: close occurrence once; natural end is factual and earns evidence only with actual coverage and heard wall threshold; infrastructure/nonpersonal outcome closes measurement with no taste evidence

preference.effect: track-scoped explicit preference; newest normalized timestamp wins; same timestamp uses serialized event order; never decays

ledgerFields.producers: ordinal sorted unique {producerId,through:int>=0,pending:sorted unique sequence integers>through+1}

trackFields.evidenceAtMs: safe timestamp|null; phase anchor for integer decay
trackFields.lastHeardAtMs: safe timestamp|null; max actual interval event time, never activation/planning time

occurrenceFields.occurrenceId: opaque actual playback occurrence ID, distinct from stable queue entryId
occurrenceFields.clocks: unique [{clockId,throughMs}] service boot monotonic overlap watermarks
occurrenceFields.heardCredited: boolean; at least one actual interval counted
occurrenceFields.ended: boolean; late intervals and outcomes cannot change closed measurement

formulas.effectiveNowMs: max(injected nowMs,ledger.clockFloorMs); negative event ages clamp zero
formulas.futureTimestamp: timestamp>effectiveNow+300000 rejects without consuming event; timestamp in (effectiveNow,effectiveNow+300000] clamps to effectiveNow and increments futureClamps
formulas.decay: periods=min(8,floor(max(0,effectiveNow-evidenceAtMs)/2419200000)); positive=floor(positiveUnits/2^periods), negative likewise; adding evidence advances phase only by elapsed whole periods, never postpones decay through frequent listening
formulas.lateEvidence: new positive/negative contribution divided by 2^min(8,floor(max(0,effectiveNow-eventTimestamp)/decayPeriodMs)) before addition; each side capped120
formulas.exposure: lifetime confirmed activated counter; independent of offered and heard
formulas.noveltyPoints: clamp(12-min(12,activated*2)+opportunityDebt,0,12); unseen track12; disabled ledger returns all neutral zero/null signals
formulas.completionWall: wallMs>=min(60000,floor(knownDurationMs*500/1000)); unknown duration earns no completion evidence
formulas.naturalEndEvidence: 3 positive units iff completionCoverage AND completionWall
formulas.deliberateReplayEvidence: 1 positive unit iff userInitiated AND completionCoverage AND completionWall; activation replay counter remains factual separate
formulas.earlySkipEvidence: 2 negative units iff deliberate personal userInitiated skip, known duration, 3000<=heardWallMs<30000 and unique coverage permille<250; all other skip cases earn0
formulas.mediaProgressPlausibility: positive forward media progress <=floor(fullWallMs*speedPermille/1000)+500; zero progress, backward progress and discontinuity do not accrue
formulas.intervalOverlap: only monotonic range after throughMs for the same boot clock counts; media start clips proportionally with integer floor; genuine repeated sections add wall time but not duplicate unique coverage
formulas.coverageCompaction: merge overlapping/adjacent ranges; if adding a disjoint range exceeds64, keep previous exact ranges and increment coverageUnderflows, conservatively undercount

idempotence.preferred: eventId plus durable producerId/sequence; serialize emitter sequence and rotate producerId per independently reset producer epoch
idempotence.watermark: accept out-of-order within1024; retain pending sequence set, advance through contiguous consumed prefix; all sequences<=through or already pending are forever duplicates even after event/journal eviction
idempotence.bounds: at most64 producers, no producer eviction; first/new sequence gap>1024 or producer capacity rejection is retryable and consumes no event ID
idempotence.arbitraryIdsOnly: deduplicate only most recent4096 accepted IDs; IDs outside retained window may apply again. Do not claim exactly once without durable producer sequences
idempotence.occurrenceCallbacks: retained occurrence identity prevents duplicate activation/outcome callback effects; finalized occurrence ring256; use durable sequences for callbacks replayed after pruning
idempotence.reset: learning reset retains deduplication and increments epoch; adapters should include learningEpoch to reject old-epoch events; full deletion intentionally clears deduplication and requires fresh producer epoch

acceptance.platformRequirement: service/audio adapter must close intervals at pause, seek, speed change, buffer, focus loss, source/route failure, disable and process boundary; use boot clock ID and actual activated occurrence ID; outcomes require reason/personal provenance
openGates: Windows and Android production adapters/lifecycle/persistence acceptance
audible output and human preference acceptance
acceptance.productDefaults: numerical defaults are conservative, tunable product policy; not universal musical perfection
